title: importmap
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the data map, such as the intended use or data source.

entitiesperfile.description: Choose whether a data file can contain data for one or more record types.

importmapid.description: Unique identifier of the data map.

importmaptype.description: Select the type of data map to distinguish out-of-the-box data maps from custom maps.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

isvalidforimport.description: Information about whether the data map is valid for use with data import.

iswizardcreated.description: Information about whether this data map was created by the Data Migration Manager.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the data map.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

source.description: Type the name of the migration source that this data map is used for.

sourcetype.description: Select the migration source type that this data map is used for.

sourceuseridentifierforsourcecrmuserlink.description: Source user value for source Microsoft Dynamics 365 user link.

sourceuseridentifierforsourcedatasourceu.description: Column in the source file that uniquely identifies a user.

statecode.description: Shows whether the data map is active or inactive.

targetentity.description: Select the name of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 record type that this data map is defined for.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Business unit that owns the data map.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the data map.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the data map.
